title: What Moves the Dead
author: T. Kingfisher
summary: A retelling of the Fall of the House of Usher. A retired soldier answers a childhood friend's call and arrives at a decaying family house, where the surrounding woods, the animals and the people all seem to be wrong.
readIf: you want a short, creepy gothic story with a practical narrator and a touch of dark humour.
skipIf: you dislike body horror or want a long, slow-building story.

pairings.reason: The classic haunted-house novel, with a similar quiet menace and a fragile household.
Another decaying mansion with a strange illness and a heroine who refuses to be scared off.
A short, strange story where nature itself seems to be doing something unnatural.
